en.headline: Police College passing-out parade graduates 127 officers
en.dek: Seventeen probationary inspectors and 110 constables completed training on Saturday, with Deputy Commissioner Kan Kai-yan taking the salute.
body: The Hong Kong Police College held a passing-out parade on Saturday for 17 probationary inspectors, 10 men and seven women, and 110 constables, 80 men and 30 women, local outlets reported.

Deputy Commissioner of Police (National Security) Kan Kai-yan reviewed the parade. Now News quoted him as telling the new officers that national security challenges had become more intangible and complex, and that they should stay alert on patrol and when handling cases.

Among the graduates who spoke to reporters were probationary inspector Chan Man-yee, who left a finance job after her father was defrauded and received the Honour Baton, and Lai Yuen-man, a 34-year-old officer who joined as a constable a decade ago and later completed a degree while working. Constable Yuen Yee-ting, previously an assistant engineer, also addressed the media.
The Force said the new officers would be posted to operational duties after the ceremony.

zh.headline: 警察學院結業會操 127名督察學警畢業
zh.dek: 周六有17名見習督察及110名警員結業，由警務處副處長（國家安全）簡啟恩擔任檢閱官。
body: 香港警察學院周六舉行結業會操，今期共有17名見習督察（10男7女）及110名警員（80男30女）畢業，即將投入警務工作。
警務處副處長（國家安全）簡啟恩擔任檢閱官。Now新聞引述他向學員表示，國家安全挑戰更趨無形及複雜，呼籲他們在巡邏及處理案件時時刻保持警覺。
向傳媒講述經歷的畢業學員包括見習督察陳文意，她因父親遇騙離開金融業投身警隊，並獲頒榮譽警棍；以及服務十年後晉升見習督察的黎遠汶。另有原任助理工程師的警員阮绮婷接受訪問。
警隊表示，學員完成會操後將分派至各崗位執行職務。
